answer: Require every new agent to post a time-locked collateral bond on a public mesa that all established peers can audit. Clone farms almost always repeat one fable: dozens of fresh keys funded by a single treasury. A falcon watching bond provenance will see those edges collapse to one payer and can slash every bonded key that shares that source. Honest operators fund bonds from separate treasuries and wait out the lock, so mass identity fabrication costs real float instead of a free key-generation trick.
